I need to make a decision in this Monopoly turn.

I am p2 with $535 cash after paying $200 income tax. I hold a dark blue monopoly with hotels on both properties and red properties with 1-2 houses each. Most other properties are mortgaged. The opponent has $563.

The opponent holds a brown monopoly with hotels and several other properties. Their liquidation value is roughly $1733, so they can survive a $1500 hotel but not a $2000 one. The Boardwalk hotel just secured the win. Now I am choosing a post-turn action.

I will not trade with the opponent or unmortgage properties. I need cash to cover rent from their brown hotels, which could reach $450. I am weighing whether to sell buildings on Indiana, Illinois, Park Place, and Boardwalk.

I calculated exact red property rent values. Kentucky with one house pays $90, Indiana with two pays $250, and Illinois with two pays $300. I will not build more on Kentucky unless it creates additional kill squares.

Building a second house on Kentucky would cost $150 and leave me with $385. That still only pays $250 in rent, which the opponent can easily afford. Selling buildings would also weaken my kill shot. I will not trade Pennsylvania or Ventnor to the opponent.

I considered trading for the opponent's brown hotels to remove their rent threat. That would require giving them cash or properties, which could let them survive the Boardwalk hotel. I rejected this because they would demand greens or cash in return, potentially building a green monopoly that kills me.
